featuresUsed: AI NavGrid, Group, formation and MoveTo

evidence.action: Play the actual Repair Corridor game, pause its live AI world, request group AUTO radius, A-to-B, flow field, clearance, formation and guard perception; render layers on the D3D viewport.
evidence.actual: Group serial 5 AUTO radius .40000000596, field ready, A-to-B found, gate cell clearance .875 and walkable. Manual radius 1.0 makes that cell non-walkable and probe partial. Guard serial 1 FSM history Patrol→Pause→Patrol; separate perception response has 34 lines. The selected-group overlay BMP visibly contains grid/cost/clearance, field, formation slots and probe.

evidence.action: Compare AUTO and explicit 1.0 radius on the same selected group and gateway cell, then repeat AUTO on final SDK020b.
evidence.actual: AUTO tracks the 0.4m living soldiers; gateway clearance is 0.875m. Explicit 1.0 radius cannot cross. Final clean Play response again reports AUTO radius .40000000596 and configured group field.

evidence.action: Issue a line order, toggle F once, verify old slots persist until the next RMB, then wait for the new column order around the physical gate/barrier.
evidence.actual: The final SDK020b run accepted the second order and reached Arrived. Diagnostics says movement Arrived; all three selected agents remain connected and barrierViolationFrames=0. S2 ends at (-.791471,-.971346), assigned slot (-.875,-.925), approximately .095m away. The guard later captures the squad (lost=1), so this route is not a campaign victory.

evidence.action: Repeat the exact long fresh-archive column-order request before the final path/projection correction.

On the first SDK020 correction it stopped again at (1.26075,-1.23988), slot (-.875,-.925), before loss. These are preserved failing reproductions, not final behavior.

evidence.action: Repeat that unchanged long request after STRATEGY-020b using the explicit final Runtime SDK.
evidence.actual: ProjectTools build validated and activated; commandlet exit 0. evidence.action: Attempt to open the project in the actual Editor and visually inspect its AI panel.
evidence.actual: The correct Runtime editor process launched, but screenshot-only CUA window-state capture hung twice (STRATEGY-018); this agent never visually inspected the Qt panel on the project. The real API and D3D overlay were inspected through project.input instead. Root separately reports its native UI/API check passed; that does not count as this project's manual layout review.

evidence.action: Preserve two incorrect project.input invocations from early work.
evidence.actual: An unsupported {kind:resume} step returned unknown project.input step; a later request exceeded the documented 600-frame per-step bound. Both were invocation mistakes, not Engine defects; corrected runs used documented control.action and 600+400 frames.

limitations: Main.scene.json is empty; the level is procedurally built only when Play starts.
Navigation uses the existing NavGrid and group flow field; no general NavMesh or full pathfinding authoring workflow was added.
This agent did not manually inspect the Qt AI panel on its project due STRATEGY-018; the real diagnostics API and overlay were inspected in actual Play.
The final long route reached Arrived, but the guard captured the squad afterward; the final outcome is loss, not victory.
